context.summary: The rule is unsatisfiable as written, so every legitimate brief or contract edit looks like a violation, and a real violation of the spine looks like nothing. Approved §A and frozen contracts are already hashed (frozen-text-changed); the spine and drafts are not.

options.tradeoff: Name the owner-edited prose files in the spine (brief.md before approval, draft contracts, spine, research); add a hashed SpineApproved-style event so `check` reports unapproved spine edits. Small change.
Add CLI writers for every prose file (`task brief`, `contract edit`, `spine propose`). Strict and auditable, more commands.
Reword the rule only. No detection of unapproved spine edits.

data.question: Spine §8 says nobody edits .ekumen/ by hand after the switch, but brief.md, contract bodies, the spine and research files have no CLI writer (docs/cli.md says to write brief.md yourself). The spine has no hash or approval event. Which files are owner-edited prose, and how are spine changes approved?
data.title: Which .ekumen files may be edited by hand after the switch
